import bpy,bmesh,json
from pathlib import Path
bank=bpy.data.objects['M14 continuous sculpted shore bank'];me=bank.data
env=bpy.app.driver_namespace['ground15']['sample'].__globals__
baseheight=env['baseheight']
# The untouched outer grid merely duplicated the original seabed and must not
# be part of this raised ground object or its collision surface.
bm=bmesh.new();bm.from_mesh(me)
remove=[f for f in bm.faces if all(v.co.z<=float(baseheight(v.co.x,v.co.y))+.0005 for v in f.verts)]
count=len(remove);bmesh.ops.delete(bm,geom=remove,context='FACES')
loose=[v for v in bm.verts if not v.link_faces]
if loose:bmesh.ops.delete(bm,geom=loose,context='VERTS')
bm.to_mesh(me);bm.free();me.update()
assert me.color_attributes.get('GroundTint')
bank['ground15_trimmed_buried_perimeter']=count
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
(root/'captures/shipyard_ground_20261115/bank_collision_fix.json').write_text(json.dumps({'removed_faces':count,'remaining_vertices':len(me.vertices),'remaining_faces':len(me.polygons),'reason':'Remove unused buried perimeter and duplicated seabed. Raised bank keeps real collision; route unchanged.'},indent=2),encoding='utf8')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('BANK_UNUSED_PERIMETER_REMOVED',count,len(me.polygons))
